description: Java source code for an Android activity 'Bouncer2' with an inner custom view class 'MyView' that performs a bouncing animation of a bitmap image using ValueAnimator and AccelerateInterpolator.

classes.name: Bouncer2
classes.description: Main activity class that sets the content view.

classes.name: MyView
classes.description: Custom View class that displays a bitmap and animates its Y position with bouncing effect.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: setShapeX
methods.description: Sets the X position of the shape and invalidates the affected area.

methods.name: setShapeY
methods.description: Sets the Y position of the shape and invalidates the affected area.

methods.name: setupShape
methods.description: Loads the bitmap resource and sets up click listener to start animation.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Centers the shape horizontally when the view size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the bitmap at current position.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts a ValueAnimator with bounce animation using AccelerateInterpolator.

methods.name: getValueAnimator
methods.description: Creates a ValueAnimator that updates the shape's Y position based on animation fraction.
